question: What complete-set component counts do explicit schoolbook/Karatsuba/Newton backends produce on identical retained targets, with A/A and unaffected lookup controls?

claims.text: Successful rows agree with complete scalar subtraction and separate wide replay.
Report descriptive paired multiplication counts at query scope; no inferential, external-fastest, timing or whole-DLP claim.

arms.description: Karatsuba plus Newton division for long quotients.
Exact repeated newton arm; deterministic count control.
Prepared batched subtraction; generic component control.
Same lookup under unused polynomial mode; counts must be invariant.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Input-level conditioned sums go through every arm and must return a nonempty complete set. Separate independent product/division identities exercise the Newton code even if short-quotient Euclid never uses it.

null_population.description: Identical targets through batched lookup whose polynomial mode is unused.
null_population.generator: Same fixture policy v1 as all other arms; backend flag changed only.
null_population.why_n: One unaffected-path comparison per retained target; descriptive exact-count invariance, no distributional inference.

factors.name: field_and_m
factors.how: Keep every configuration separate; component fixtures explain standard-panel exception.

factors.name: target_population
factors.how: Alternating inputs, same exact target across all arms; identity separate.

factors.name: instrument
factors.value: One immutable native release binary, locked dependencies, one CPU.

factors.name: arm_order
factors.value: cyclic offset per target, reversed on odd target index
factors.how: Six interleaved arms, no per-method target selection.

factors.name: host_environment
factors.how: Unmodified isolated_bench CPU4; missing PSI/unmovable host threads mean below-L2 clocks.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Raw per-input values/ranges retained; no statistical significance test.

seed_derivation.note: Exact poly_compare.rs fixture policy v1: 0x76696574612d7631 XOR m, existing random_point and fixed base-index sums; root seed42+i identical across arms. Source frozen.

instance_sampling.rule: [['p224', 8192]]; 0 warmups then 2 retained alternating random-x-rational and conditioned sums. Random-x reduction/canonical sqrt sign are not uniform-point sampling.

blinding.how: Explicitly unblinded deterministic descriptive counts; no inferential selection.

power.note: Descriptive exact per-target observations, medians/ranges; not powered for population significance or exponent claims.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Separate word62/m32 bootstrap: 12 arm calls complete and replayed; isolated thin-driver wall 0.0175705530000414 seconds, zero other-process CPU reported. This is not extrapolated across degrees/fields. The declared3600 seconds is an enforced shared envelope, not a fitted forecast.

primary.name: Primitive multiplications
primary.definition: All multiplications inside each independent stage, including inverse/sqrt internals; cold accounting includes declared reusable setup.

primary.name: Complete ordered relations
primary.definition: Length and SHA-256 of sorted complete pair set, compared across arms and replayed by wide scalar subtraction.

secondary.name: Stage wall interval
secondary.definition: First to last stage operation, fixture generation excluded; include cold setup separately. Do not interpret without admitted host/A-A receipts. Local diagnostic only: PSI absent and unmovable host threads; wall_valid=false for L2 comparisons.
secondary.resolution: monotonic Instant, actual host resolution recorded

stopping_rules.rule: 1 configurations x6 arms x(0 warmups+2 retained)=12 query rows. Stage cap30s, multiplication cap4e9. Main+supplemental share one3600s attempt; preflight120s separate. Retain all failures/missing rows.
Set mismatch or positive-control miss invalidates its input; preserve failed rows, no retry. Complete remaining arms after a budget failure.

decision_rule.text: Descriptive per-input counts only after complete output checks/replay. Warm query interval excludes separately recorded shared setup and scalar complete-set verification. No cold full-solve, timing, fastest-backend or significance claim. All incomplete rows retained.
decision_rule.statistic: Native per-population median/min/max and all values; paired ratios only on matched completed cells.
decision_rule.interval: Observed range, not a confidence interval.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Explicit numerator/denominator multiplication ratio at component query scope; no exponent fit.

inadmissible: Change frozen inputs/arms/budgets or silently retry failures
Pool primary/supplemental, identity/finite or the two target populations
Treat below-L2 clocks or generic-reference counts as external-fastest/full-DLP gains
Treat bootstrap envelope as a measured runtime forecast
Promote producer checks to independent signed standing

literature.claim: Existing standard Karatsuba/Newton/counting patterns and component references.
literature.verified_by: Producer source read; KB MCP/wrapper unavailable.

literature.claim: Standard reversed-series Newton division and short-quotient classical fallback; no novelty.

invalidation_rules: Counted results require complete-set equality and separate-process replay.
All local wall values are diagnostic, wall_valid=false for L2 claims, even when the isolated runner reports no detected contention.
Retain failures, timeouts, missing rows and warmups; report their actual flow.

extensions.user_authorization: Explicit local/Git-only authorization retained through requested continuation; no cloud spend.
extensions.standard_panel_exception: Reuse exact prior power-of-two coset fixtures to attribute arithmetic changes; word62 has no asserted prime subgroup order. P224 standard curve.
extensions.preflight: Separate bootstrap calibration only; primary freeze updated with its receipt before main data.
